ShortDescription.Value: Choose exactly which buildings may grow in each zoning area (district).

Publish.LongDescription:
# Custom Zones
Create **zoning palettes** (named building whitelists) using a filterable building browser (zone type, density, lot size, level, theme, text search), then assign a palette to any district. Inside that district, **only the selected buildings will spawn** - everything else is filtered out at birth.
## Features - Saved palettes submenu: create, rename, duplicate, delete. - Building browser with thumbnails (Asset Icon Library) and Find It-style filters. - Per-district assignment, persisted in the savegame. - Optional retroactive enforcement of existing buildings.
## Recommended companion mods - Asset Icon Library (building thumbnails) - Unified Icon Library (UI icons)
